item.title: Claude Code Hands‑On Session for Developers in Garden Grove
item.description:
Claude Code Hands‑On Session for Developers in Garden Grove

If you have been curious about how Claude Code can streamline your development workflow, a casual, hands‑on session is being hosted in Garden Grove.

📅 Event Overview

  • Walk through the basics of setting up Claude Code, navigating its features, and troubleshooting common hurdles.
  • The session is informal, not a formal lecture.

🎯 Who Should Attend

  • Any developer who enjoys experimenting with AI‑assisted coding.
  • Whether you use Claude Code daily or just installed it yesterday, you will fit right in.

🛠 What to Bring

  • Your laptop.
  • A project you are currently working on, so the group can test things out in real time.

🤝 Participation Details

  • Participants will open laptops, try out prompts, and share what they have learned so far.
  • Let the organizers know you are coming by clicking the RSVP button.

#ClaudeCode #AIcoding #DeveloperMeetup #AItools
